title: Prove a common precision format for the current ideal compiler (no new κ)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

For the stated ideal current uniform complex compiler, proves the sufficient format F=p+D fractional bits and W=p+h+2D+3 signed bits PER real/imaginary component, with W+6 temporary bits. No child-grid reset or assumed compiler precision closure is used.

The proof retains original input provenance across unfinished calls, charges the Clifford denominator once on the complete root selected factor, and combines #4586's credited rank contraction with actual compiler scheduling. It derives K(n)<=v*m*(1+floor(log2(n)))^2. At the current constants, the exact 7,455-bit K_star satisfies 32*K_star<2^8299<2^H without constructing N=2^H.

The same format covers the specified numerical 05-layers wrapper, including q0 preprocessing, sequential pieces and final H0 normalization; odd dimensions require the proved Gaussian numerator parity.

**No new κ.** Earlier #2287/#2390/#4359 already established an O(p) common format. The contribution is this explicit current-source composition and format.

## Sources and reproduction

Base: `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`. SOURCES.json pins 14 canonical input/provenance files. DEPENDENCIES.json pins seven byte-identical theorem exports from published `c46339035fccd571effb48434d80f572e20f1092` and #6878's `41febf890fbbb852c6059d4c0cc8c593ae9dfa5c`. The latter remains unmerged. No local-only Git object is required.

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/compiled-root-clifford-precision
```

Expected: two `PASS_COMPILED_ROOT_CLIFFORD_PRECISION` markers and `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`.

## Validation and remaining work

Executed registered normal/optimized checks, committed-byte/mode checks and a Git-free exported replay in both modes. Evidence includes 12 complete small source-compiler traces, 72 recurrence cases, exact Clifford/grid checks and two separate mathematical reviews. Controls reject premature parent resumption, aliased exits, early release, scalar debt errors, active-coordinate projections, interrupted swaps, source corruption and retaining an undersized word after increasing precision. Consumed source bytes are immutable authenticated snapshots.

The written proof establishes the all-size claim; finite traces are not enormous native executions. Ideal owned resets and restored endpoints remain premises. Physical native interiors, the current front/back reservation dispatcher, actual owner presentation, all paid setup/lifecycle/native costs and outer analytic admission remain separate. Final output truncation remains explicit and paid. Dependency generators are not rerun here.

Prepared for @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Credit DreamingOfClouds, Ross Richardson, zxv, Jacob Alan Sussman, #5443's lockstep work and the retained native, precision and occurrence contributors. Separate AI reviews are not human or formal-kernel acceptance. Apache-2.0.
